title: DTF Terpene Atlas measured sample profiles
rules: Each profile represents one measured sample or one explicitly defined pooled sample.
Cultivar or strain labels are metadata, not a substitute for measurements.
A profile must record source, matrix, analytical method when available, unit, and measurement values.
Below-LOD, below-LOQ, not-tested and measured-zero states must remain distinct.
DTF breeding-line names must not receive percentages until a laboratory or traceable study supplies measurements.
